root_idea.summary: The root centers on an origin or firm, enduring foundation: the base from which a structure or thing is established.
root_idea.development: From the physical foundation or base, the lexical field extends to beginning, source, root, and figurative establishment. The Form II verb denotes laying or providing such a foundation.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The sole QAC group is a Quran-attested Form II verb and is presented under its normalized classical citation form.

senses.definition: To found or establish a building or structure by laying its foundation; to base it upon a foundation or basis.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranic usage includes both active and passive forms and concerns a building or structure, including one founded upon a specified basis.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To build a house or structure, or to lay its foundation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I lexical usage distinct from the Quran-attested Form II grouping.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To commence the construction of a building.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical usage emphasizing the beginning of construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The foundation, basis, or lowest part of a building or wall; also the beginning or commencement of a building or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal usage for the supporting base or starting point of something.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The origin, source, stock, or root of a person or thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An extended usage treating the origin or source as the foundational element.
A traditional anatomical conception connected with the heart as an originating part in the womb.
Used idiomatically in expressions such as عَلَى أُسِّ الدَّهْرِ, meaning in old time or at the beginning of time.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A remnant, relic, trace, vestige, sign, mark, or track; also the remains of ashes between hearthstones.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may denote a mark or track used to follow a way, or residue specifically left among hearthstones.
